messages:
Ava: Quick one 11 Should the Console show SLO rules that are routed into the new de-emphasis lane as "active" or hide them? Folks are confused when they see a threshold crossed but no pager.
Tom: I'd show them but with a clear state badge: "de-emphasized" (muted grey + tooltip explaining policy). Hiding = surprises.
Priya: We need telemetry hooks too. For each SLO: raw_hits, de_emphasized_count, sampled_estimate, and an estimate of "would_have_paged". The preview UX should let users toggle to simulate blowups.
Sam: API idea: extend notify policy like: `suppress_mode` seems ok but prefer `deemphasis_mode` with enum values ["none", "deemphasize", "soft_snooze"]. We'll add `deemphasis_tags` and `bypass_tags`.
Ava: Draft payload for update (example):
```json
{
  "slo_id": "payments/checkout_latency_p95",
  "notify_policy": "{\"deemphasis_mode\":\"deemphasize\",\"deemphasis_window_s\":3600,\"sampling\":0.05,\"bypass_tags\":[\"team:core\"]}"
}
```
Elena: UX copy nit: avoid "suppress" or "mute". Suggest "de-emphasize" or "route to low-priority". And show a short line: "X events routed to de-emphasis in last 24h (click to preview)".
Maya: Rollout considerations: if de-emphasized events don't count against notify quotas tenants will abuse it. We should count them for quota/cost but exclude them from oncall escalation math. Emit both counters.
Priya: Agreed. Telemetry event names: `slo.event.raw`, `slo.event.routed.deemphasize`, `slo.event.estimate.paged`. Include tenant_id and sampling flags. Also a dashboard tile: "De-emphasis savings" showing estimated pages avoided and estimated cost saved.
Tom: Edge-case: per-entity bypass. Some signals need always-on paging (eg tag:service=payments-critical). Add `bypass_selector` which can be simple label match.
Sam: Implementation note: notifier service will need to return a `policy_applied` object per event for tracing. e.g., {applied: true, mode: 'deemphasize', sampled: false}. We'll emit to tracing so Console can show a per-event timeline.
alert-bot: notifier-service v2.14 deploy started -> staging
Ava: UX proposal: SLO card header shows small pill "De-emphasized" with a flyout listing reasons + last 7d suppressed count and a "Preview would-have-fired" toggle that overlays simulated escalations.
Maya: Also add a migration path: existing notify policies default to `none`. During opt-in rollout we run a simulation job for 48h to surface expected behavior for tenants.
Priya: Metrics to monitor during FF: de-emphasis_rate, paging_false_negative_rate, paging_savings_estimate, quota_consumption_delta. Alert on any unexpected spike in false_negative_rate.
Elena: Small accessibility note: make the pill keyboard-focusable and include clear aria-labels for screen readers.
Tom: Sounds good. @Ava can you file a short RFC: schema, sample queries, dashboard widgets, migration steps, and a small UI mock? Also include the exact telemetry names so backends and dashboards align.
Ava: Will do. I'll add a short rollout checklist: FF internal 10% -> beta on 5 tenants -> broader beta -> GA. Attach mockups + SQL queries for dashboard. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alert-bot: notifier-service v2.14 deploy succeeded -> staging (09:13)
